```python
import re

def is_happy(s):
    if len(s) < 3:
        return False

    pattern = re.compile(r'((.)\1\2)|(.\3\4)' for letter in set(s))
    result = any(not pattern.search(s[i:i+3]) for i in range(len(s)-2))

    return not result
```
